name: ReceiptBatch_getCreditTransactionDetailsBatch
description: Read-only batch metadata lookup for every credit receipt of one report.
command:
-- Read-only batch metadata lookup for every credit receipt of one report.
-- REPORT_NUMBER is the report id, escaped for a SQL string literal by the
-- caller. CREDIT_TRANSACTION is converted with the same regex guard used by
-- the existing single-transaction lookup; no unguarded TO_NUMBER is used.
-- No DML, status filter or payment-type filter.
WITH credit_receipts AS (
    SELECT r.RECEIPT_ID,
           r.CREDIT_TRANSACTION AS REQUESTED_TRANSACTION_ID,
           TO_NUMBER(CASE
               WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(TRIM(r.CREDIT_TRANSACTION), '^[0-9]+$')
               THEN TRIM(r.CREDIT_TRANSACTION)
           END) AS TRANSACTION_ID
    FROM   XX_AP_BATCH_RECEIPTS r
    WHERE  r.REPORT_ID = '${REPORT_NUMBER}'
    AND    REGEXP_LIKE(r.CREDIT_TRANSACTION, '[^[:space:]]')
)
SELECT NVL(
           JSON_ARRAYAGG(
               JSON_OBJECT(
                   'RECEIPT_ID' VALUE TO_CHAR(cr.RECEIPT_ID),
                   'REQUESTED_TRANSACTION_ID' VALUE cr.REQUESTED_TRANSACTION_ID,
                   'TRANSACTION_ID' VALUE TO_CHAR(t.trx_id),
                   'CARD_ID' VALUE TO_CHAR(c.card_id),
                   'CARD_NUMBER' VALUE icc.masked_cc_number,
                   'CARD_LABEL' VALUE cp.card_program_name || ' ' || icc.masked_cc_number,
                   'TRANSACTION_DATE' VALUE TO_CHAR(t.transaction_date, 'DD-Mon-YYYY', 'NLS_DATE_LANGUAGE=English'),
                   'TRANSACTION_DATE_ISO' VALUE TO_CHAR(t.transaction_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD'),
                   'TRANSACTION_AMOUNT' VALUE CASE
                       WHEN t.transaction_amount < 0
                       THEN '<' || TO_CHAR(ABS(t.transaction_amount), 'FM999G999G999G999G990D00', 'NLS_NUMERIC_CHARACTERS=''.,''') || '>'
                       ELSE TO_CHAR(ABS(t.transaction_amount), 'FM999G999G999G999G990D00', 'NLS_NUMERIC_CHARACTERS=''.,''')
                   END || ' ' || t.posted_currency_code,
                   'TRANSACTION_AMOUNT_NUMBER' VALUE t.transaction_amount,
                   'CURRENCY_CODE' VALUE t.posted_currency_code,
                   'MERCHANT_NAME' VALUE t.merchant_name1,
                   'LOCATION' VALUE AP_WEB_DB_CCARD_PKG.GetLocation(t.merchant_city, t.merchant_province_state),
                   'BILLED_AMOUNT' VALUE t.billed_amount,
                   'BILLED_CURRENCY_CODE' VALUE t.billed_currency_code,
                   'PAYMENT_DUE_FROM_CODE' VALUE t.payment_due_from_code
                   NULL ON NULL
                   RETURNING CLOB
               )
               ORDER BY cr.RECEIPT_ID
               RETURNING CLOB
           ),
           TO_CLOB('[]')
       ) AS "CREDIT_TRANSACTIONS"
FROM   credit_receipts cr
JOIN   ap_credit_card_trxns_all t
ON     t.trx_id = cr.TRANSACTION_ID
JOIN   ap_cards_all c
ON     c.card_id = t.card_id
AND    c.card_program_id = t.card_program_id
AND    c.org_id = t.org_id
JOIN   ap_card_programs_all cp
ON     cp.card_program_id = c.card_program_id
AND    cp.org_id = c.org_id
JOIN   iby_creditcard icc
ON     c.card_reference_id = icc.instrid
